1) 用 cat /proc/\u003cpid\u003e/limits 确认: 1) Run cat /proc/<pid>/limits to see the soft and hard Max open files; 2) For systemd services add LimitNOFILE=65535 to the unit, then daemon-reload and restart; 3) For non-systemd add ulimit -n 65535 to the startup script or edit /etc/security/limits.conf; 4) Note the process must be restarted for a changed soft limit to take effect.
1) 用 ps -ef | grep \u003c进程关键字\u003e 确认确: 1) Run ps -ef | grep <process keyword> to confirm it is really gone and rule out a wrong match rule on the collector side; 2) Check its log and dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' to tell a crash, an OOM kill and a manual stop apart; 3) Start it through the service's own procedure and confirm the systemd Restart policy works; 4) If it keeps exiting, find the root cause before starting it again to avoid a restart loop.
被监控的进程数为 0，进程已经不在了，它承载的功能全部中断。: The monitored process count is 0 — the process is gone and everything it serves is down.
进程的文件句柄软上限低于 2048，高并发时很容易触顶报 Too many op: The process's soft file handle limit is below 2048, which tops out easily under concurrency with Too many open files — and it usually only surfaces at peak traffic.
